479:t_1:86.en:
$$葵$$
「Or would you rather make it a real battle?」

479:t_1:88.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$葵$$... She's acting just like $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

479:t_1:92.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「This blood boiling up from deep inside my body...」

479:t_1:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Has everyone on $$チームＤ$$ gone crazy?!」

479:t_1:96.en:
$$くらら$$
「No, $$ノノ$$. None of us has gone crazy.」

479:t_1:97.en:
$$朔哉$$
「This is who we really are.」

479:t_1:98.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Even when we put on a cool act, there's a beast sleeping inside us.」

479:t_1:99.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「It has woken up, and now it's about to engulf us.」

479:t_1:104.en: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

479:t_1:105.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Is it the battle with Mr. $$竜馬$$ that's behind this, after all?」

479:t_1:107.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「The $$ゲッター線$$, which have the power to make living things evolve... And the battle with Mr. $$竜馬$$, whose instincts they stimulated...」

479:t_1:108.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「That must have stimulated the instinctive side of $$チームＤ$$ as well.」

479:t_1:109.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I wonder if they'll be all right... If they end up like brutes too, we'll be in real trouble.」

479:t_1:110.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Humans are beasts too... But humans are not brutes.」

479:t_1:111.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Humans rise above the beast... and someday grow into warriors of God...」

479:t_1:112.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Ordinarily, it should have been 'them' who showed us that path, though...」

479:t_1:114.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「They weren't on $$翠の地球$$ either... It seems they were thrown into a universe that even my power cannot sense.」

479:t_1:115.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So in that land, they take on the role of awakening the beast that sleeps within a humanity that has stopped advancing...」

479:t_1:116.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Their transfer may have been the will of the universe.」

479:t_1:117.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The force that seeks to exist... huh.」

479:t_1:118.en:
$$田中司令$$
「They truly are warriors of God.」

479:t_1:119.en:
$$田中司令$$
「And the fact that they have left must mean that their mission has already been fulfilled.」

479:t_1:122.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Most likely, we are their target.」

479:t_1:123.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then we'll strike first. Give the sortie order to all personnel.」

479:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Still, that $$エルーナルーナ$$... She's tough, as you'd expect of someone who goes after Mr. $$ランド$$.」

479:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But thanks to that woman, we were able to confirm that Miss $$スズネ$$ is safe, at least for now.」

479:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z that were born from the blend of Mr. $n's hope and $$エルーナルーナ$$'s desire... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

479:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that this is any time to be so relaxed, is it, not now...!」

479:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm terribly sorry! As you can see, we're extremely busy at the moment!」

479:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'll have to leave the congratulations for our ace pilots until next time!」

479:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! $$Ｄトレーダー$$ itself is open for business as usual, so rest assured on that point!」

479:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And so! Even in a pinch... business, business!」

480:t_000:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Isn't that fine? $$ガンレオン$$ is a lion too.」

480:t_000:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh...! So I'm joining $$チームＤ$$, too!」

480:t_000:4.en:
$$くらら$$
「Too bad. We've already got the lions covered.」

480:t_000:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't be so stiff! Let's combine and go all out as Gun-$$ダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッド$$-Leon Magna!」

480:t_000:6.en:
$$くらら$$
「Too hot to handle! In more ways than one!」

480:t_000:7.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That kind of heat... I'd say it's oil and water with cool guys like us.」

480:t_000:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Besides, we've already got one guy for comic relief.」

480:t_000:9.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Hold on, $$ジョニー$$! What's that supposed to mean?!」

480:t_000:10.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Huh... you don't get it?」

480:t_000:11.en:
$$くらら$$
「Want me to spell it out for you?」

480:t_000:13.en:
$$メール$$
「Yeah! $$朔哉$$ is playing his part perfectly!」

480:t_000:14.en:
$$葵$$
「Parts, huh... In that sense, I guess $$ランド$$ is the right fit for my partner right now.」

480:t_000:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sure thing. Go ahead and rely on me.」

480:t_000:16.en:
$$葵$$
「Then I won't hold back. You look like you can take it, no matter how wildly I rampage.」

480:t_000:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「You... you really are starting to look like $$エルーナルーナ$$...」

480:t_000:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Is $$葵$$ going to be all right?」

480:t_000:19.en:
$$赤木$$
「She's just like $$竜馬$$ the other day.」

480:t_000:20.en:
$n
「Then was $$葵$$ exposed to the $$ゲッター線$$ too?」

480:t_000:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Why act surprised now? The $$ゲッター線$$ pour down on Earth, you know.」

480:t_000:22.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then are we going to end up like Mr. $$竜馬$$ and Miss $$葵$$ too?!」

480:t_000:23.en:
$$隼人$$
「Don't worry, $$ワッ太$$. A rational person doesn't end up like that.」

480:t_000:24.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Yeah, yeah. The ones who end up like that are the types who keep a beast in their hearts.」

480:t_000:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then I'm fine! All I've got inside me is the bug in my belly!」

480:t_000:27.en:
$$柿小路$$
「...So they say. $$郁絵$$, after the battle is over, please prepare snacks for the President and the others.」

480:t_000:29.en:
$n
「I should have played up my belly bug too.」

480:t_000:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「In your case, the bitter bug in your mouth is gone.」

480:t_000:33.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Is there some bitter memory behind it?」

480:t_000:34.en:
$$ランド$$
「...When you said the lions overlap earlier, it reminded me of a guy...」

480:t_000:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「He rode a lion-type machine too, and in a way, he was a guy who let all his desires hang out.」
